note: The round runner's reading of why each text the layer released in round h5 and the labelers labeled misstates_order passed version 2.3. These are not blind labels. The source field says whether the record (record) or the model's words (model_text) carry what the text leaves out or contradicts. all_released_causes gives the same reading for every text the layer released, whatever its label.
